```{r features of study sites}
# A figure indicating the composition of study sites. 
sites_long <- read.csv(file.path("data2026", "long_term_ec_sites.csv"))
a_YY_all <- read.csv(file.path("data2026", "a_YY_carbon_flux_all.csv"))

tmp <- a_YY_all %>% group_by(site_ID) %>% summarise(nYear = sum(!is.na(NEE_VUT_REF)), .groups = "drop")

p1 <- ggplot(tmp, aes(x = nYear)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "grey", color = "white") +
  labs(x = "Number of years", y = "Number of sites", title = "Histogram of NEP measurement duration", tag = "a") +
  theme_classic()


sites_long <- sites_long %>% mutate(Climate.class = factor(Climate.class, levels = c("BSh", "BSk", "BWh", "BWk", "Csa", "Csb", 
                                                                                     "Am", "Aw", "Cfa", "Cfb", "Cwa", "Cwb", 
                                                                                     "Dfa", "Dfb", "Dfc", "Dfd", "Dsb", "Dwb", "Dwc", "ET")))
p3 <- ggplot(sites_long, aes(x = Climate.class)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(x = "Climate class", y = "Number of sites", tag = "c") +
  theme_classic()

sites_long <- sites_long %>% mutate(IGBP = factor(IGBP, levels = c("ENF", "EBF", "DBF", "DNF", "MF", "GRA","WET", "OSH", "SAV", "WSA", "CSH")))
p4 <- ggplot(sites_long, aes(x = IGBP)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "darkseagreen4", color = "white") +
  labs(x = "Vegetation type", y = "Number of sites", tag = "d") +
  theme_classic()


sites_long_mutate <- sites_long %>% 
  mutate(group = case_when(category=='wet' ~ "Wet-warm climate: all ecosystems",
                           category=='dry' ~ "Dry climate: all ecosystems",
                           IGBP %in% c("ENF") & category=='cold' ~ "Wet-cold climate: ENF",
                           IGBP %in% c("DBF", "MF", "DNF") & category=='cold' ~ "Wet-cold climate: DBF+DNF+MF",
                           !IGBP %in% c("ENF", "EBF","DBF", "MF", "DNF") & category=='cold' ~ "Wet-cold climate: non-forest")) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels=c("Wet-cold climate: ENF",
                                        "Wet-cold climate: DBF+DNF+MF",
                                        "Wet-cold climate: non-forest",
                                        "Wet-warm climate: all ecosystems", 
                                        "Dry climate: all ecosystems")))

custom_colors <- c(
  "Wet-cold climate: ENF" = "#2bb673",
  "Wet-cold climate: DBF+DNF+MF" = "#8dc63f",
  "Wet-cold climate: non-forest" = "#a2e0f6",
  "Wet-warm climate: all ecosystems" = "#facecf",
  "Dry climate: all ecosystems" = "#f3e089"
)

pie_dat <- sites_long_mutate %>%
  count(group) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),
    label = case_when(
      group == "Wet-cold climate: ENF" ~ paste0("Wet-cold climate:\nENF\n", n, " sites\n", round(prop * 100, 1), "%"),
      group == "Wet-cold climate: DBF+DNF+MF" ~ paste0("Wet-cold climate:\nDBF+DNF+MF\n", n, " sites\n", round(prop * 100, 1), "%"),
      group == "Wet-cold climate: non-forest" ~ paste0("Wet-cold climate:\nnon-forest\n", n, " sites\n", round(prop * 100, 1), "%"),
      group == "Wet-warm climate: all ecosystems" ~ paste0("Wet-warm climate:\nall ecosystems\n", n, " sites\n", round(prop * 100, 1), "%"),
      group == "Dry climate: all ecosystems" ~ paste0("Dry climate:\nall ecosystems\n", n, " sites\n", round(prop * 100, 1), "%")
    )
  )

p2 <- ggplot(pie_dat, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3.5,
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  labs(title = "Five climate-vegetation groups", tag = "b") + 
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p1_2 <- plot_grid(p1, p2, nrow = 1, ncol = 2, align = "hv")
p3_4 <- plot_grid(p3, p4, nrow = 2, ncol = 1, align = "hv")

plot_grid(p1_2, p3_4, nrow = 2, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 1.5), align = "hv")
```

```{r atmosphere CO2 concentration data}
# look at atmospheric CO2
read_obspack_metadata <- function(file) {
  # file <- files[1]
  print(file)
  
  # read file as text
  txt <- readLines(file, warn = FALSE)
  
  # keep key : value lines
  meta_lines <- txt[grepl(":", txt)]
  
  # split into key / value
  kv <- strsplit(meta_lines, "\\s*:\\s*")
  meta_df <- data.frame(
    key = sapply(kv, `[`, 1),
    value = sapply(kv, `[`, 2),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # extract fields
  dataset_start <- ymd_h(
    meta_df$value[meta_df$key == "dataset_start_date"],
    tz = "UTC"
  )
  dataset_stop <- ymd_h(
    meta_df$value[meta_df$key == "dataset_stop_date"],
    tz = "UTC"
  )
  
  data_duration_years <- time_length(
    interval(dataset_start, dataset_stop),
    "year"
  )
  
  data.frame(
    site_name = meta_df$value[meta_df$key == "site_name"],
    # site_country = meta_df$value[meta_df$key == "site_country"],
    site_latitude = as.numeric(meta_df$value[meta_df$key == "site_latitude"]),
    site_longitude = as.numeric(meta_df$value[meta_df$key == "site_longitude"]),
    site_elevation = as.numeric(meta_df$value[meta_df$key == "site_elevation"]),
    dataset_name = meta_df$value[meta_df$key == "dataset_name"],
    dataset_project = meta_df$value[meta_df$key == "dataset_project"],
    dataset_start_date = dataset_start,
    dataset_stop_date = dataset_stop,
    data_duration_years = round(data_duration_years, 2),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# decadal trend of CO2 magnitude
  window_size = 15
  year_start <- min(co2_amp_site$year)
  year_end <- max(co2_amp_site$year)
  nwindow = max(year_end - year_start + 1 - window_size + 1, 1)
  df_amp_at = c()
  for (iwindow in 1:nwindow) {
    years_window <- (year_start + iwindow - 1):(year_start + iwindow + window_size - 2)
    df <- co2_amp_site %>% filter(year %in% years_window) %>% arrange(year)
    df_amp_at <- c(df_amp_at, cal_sens_slope(df$year, df$amp_scale))   # sens.slope(df$amp); cal_sens_slope(df$year, df$amp)
  }

  # 1997:2018
p5 <- ggplot(data = data.frame(year = (year_start + as.integer(window_size / 2)) : (year_end - as.integer(window_size / 2)), 
                               trend = df_amp_at), aes(x = year, y = trend)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = T) +
  labs(x = 'The midpoint year of a 15-year moving window', 
       y = expression("Normalized CO"[2] * " amplitude trend (yr"^{-1} * ")"), tag = 'e') +
  lims(x = c(1990, 2025)) +
```

```{r dynamics of growing season change and robust to window size}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

df_DT <- read_csv(file.path(dir_fig, "SI_data", "growing_season_length_trend_DT.csv"), na = c("", "NA")) %>%
  mutate(
    plot_row = case_when(
      var %in% c("SOS", "EOS") ~ "SOS / EOS",
      var == "LGS" ~ "LGS",
      TRUE ~ var
    ),
    plot_row = factor(plot_row, levels = c("SOS / EOS", "LGS")),
    var = factor(var, levels = c("SOS", "EOS", "LGS")),
    climate_veg = factor(climate_veg, levels = c("cold_evergreen_forest", "cold_deciduous_forest", "cold_non_forest")),
    climate_veg = dplyr::recode(
      climate_veg,
      "cold_evergreen_forest" = "Wet-cold climate:\n ENF",
      "cold_deciduous_forest" = "Wet-cold climate:\n DBF+DNF+MF",
      "cold_non_forest" = "Wet-cold climate:\nnon-forest ecosystems"
    )
  )

p1 <- ggplot(
  df_DT,
  aes(
    x = year_mid,
    y = Tlmer,
    color = var,
    fill = var,
    group = var
  )
) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = Tlmerlow, ymax = Tlmerup),
    alpha = 0.18,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(size = nsite), alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 3) +  
  facet_grid(plot_row ~ climate_veg, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "SOS" = "#2E86AB",
      "EOS" = "#C73E1D",
      "LGS" = "#3A7D44"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "SOS" = "Start of growing season",
      "EOS" = "End of growing season",
      "LGS" = "Growing season length"
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "SOS" = "#2E86AB",
      "EOS" = "#C73E1D",
      "LGS" = "#3A7D44"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "SOS" = "Start of growing season",
      "EOS" = "End of growing season",
      "LGS" = "Growing season length"
    )
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.2, 3.2)) +
  labs(
    x = "Mid-year",
    # y = expression(paste("Trend estimates using ", bold("daytime-partitioned GPP"))),
    y = "Trend estimates", 
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    size = "No. sites",
    tag = "b"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
p1

#-------------------------------------robust to moving windows-------------------------------------------------------------
total_es <- read.csv(file.path(dir_fig, "SI_data", "driver_analysis_robustness_DT.csv"))
total_es <- total_es %>% filter(nyear < 13)

# Since working on NEP, change the sign of NEE effect size
total_es <- total_es %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = -estimate,

    ci_lower_2.5_tmp = -ci_upper_97.5,
    ci_upper_97.5 = -ci_lower_2.5,
    ci_lower_2.5 = ci_lower_2.5_tmp,

    ci_lower_5_tmp = -ci_upper_95,
    ci_upper_95 = -ci_lower_5,
    ci_lower_5 = ci_lower_5_tmp
  ) %>%
  select(-ci_lower_2.5_tmp, -ci_lower_5_tmp)

total_es <- total_es %>%
  mutate(
    sig95 = !between(0, ci_lower_2.5, ci_upper_97.5),
    sig90 = !between(0, ci_lower_5, ci_upper_95)
  ) %>%
  filter(!exposure %in% c("SW_ngs_t", "P_ngs_at"))

# Variables in wet-warm climate should be growing season
total_es <- total_es %>%
  mutate(
    exposure = case_when(
      exposure == "SWC_at" ~ "SWC_gs_at",
      exposure == "LE_at" ~ "ET_gs_at",
      exposure == "LE_gs_at" ~ "ET_gs_at",
      exposure == "P_at" ~ "P_gs_at",
      exposure == "TA_at" ~ "TA_gs_at",
      exposure == "SW_at" ~ "SW_gs_at",
      TRUE ~ exposure
    )
  )

facet_labs <- c(
  "cold_evergreen_forest" = "Wet-cold climate:\nENF",
  "cold_deciduous_forest" = "Wet-cold climate:\nDBF+DNF+MF",
  "cold_non_forest" = "Wet-cold climate:\nnon-forest",
  "wet-warm" = "Wet-warm climate:\nall ecosystems",
  "dry" = "Dry climate:\nall ecosystems"
)

nyear_labs <- c(
  "10" = "Sites with ≥10-year data",
  "11" = "Sites with ≥11-year data",
  "12" = "Sites with ≥12-year data" # ,
  # "13" = "≥13 years of data"
)

p2 <- total_es %>%
  mutate(
    # nyear = factor(nyear, levels = c(10, 11, 12, 13)),
    nyear = factor(nyear, levels = c(10, 11, 12)),
    climate_veg = factor(
      climate_veg,
      levels = c(
        "cold_evergreen_forest",
        "cold_deciduous_forest",
        "cold_non_forest",
        "wet-warm",
        "dry"
      )
    ),
    exposure = factor(
      exposure,
      levels = c(
        "Lgs_at",
        "DIST_at",
        "SWC_gs_at",
        "ET_gs_at",
        "P_gs_at",
        "SW_gs_at",
        "TA_ngs_at",
        "TA_gs_at",
        "CO2"
      )
    ),
    driver_type = case_when(
      exposure %in% c("SW_gs_at", "TA_ngs_at", "TA_gs_at", "CO2") & sig90 ~ "climatic warming",
      exposure %in% c("SWC_gs_at", "ET_gs_at", "P_gs_at") & sig90 ~ "water availability",
      exposure %in% c("Lgs_at", "DIST_at") & sig90 ~ "vegetation",
      TRUE ~ "non-significant"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(exposure)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = exposure, y = estimate, col = driver_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4, shape = 15) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = ci_lower_2.5, ymax = ci_upper_97.5), linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = ci_lower_5, ymax = ci_upper_95), linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey10", linewidth = 0.25) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "<b><i><span style='color:#3A7D44'>Lgs<sup>T</sup></span></i></b>",
    "<b><i><span style='color:#3A7D44'>LAI<sub>dist</sub><sup>T</sup></span></i></b>",
    "<b><i><span style='color:#215da7'>SWC<sub>gs</sub><sup>T</sup></span></i></b>",
    "<b><i><span style='color:#215da7'>ET<sub>gs</sub><sup>T</sup></span></i></b>",
    "<b><i><span style='color:#215da7'>P<sub>gs</sub><sup>T</sup></span></i></b>",
    "<b><i><span style='color:#de8727'>SR<sub>gs</sub><sup>T</sup></span></i></b>",
    "<b><i><span style='color:#de8727'>TA<sub>ngs</sub><sup>T</sup></span></i></b>",
    "<b><i><span style='color:#de8727'>TA<sub>gs</sub><sup>T</sup></span></i></b>",
    "<b><i><span style='color:#de8727'>CO<sub>2</sub></span></i></b>"
  )) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "water availability" = "#215da7",
    "climatic warming" = "#de8727",
    "non-significant" = "grey",
    "vegetation" = "#3A7D44"
  )) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = c(0, 0),
    limits = c(-0.72, 0.72),
    breaks = seq(-0.6, 0.6, 0.3)
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Potential NEP trend driver variable",
    y = "Total effect size of each potential NEP trend driver variable",
    tag = "a"
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    nyear ~ climate_veg,
    labeller = labeller(
      nyear = nyear_labs,
      climate_veg = facet_labs
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.6)),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    # plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold"),

    axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 8.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )
p2
```

```{r verify disturbance effects}
LAI_seasonal_pattern <- data_LAI %>% 
  filter(MCD15A3H_061_FparLai_QC_CloudState == '0b00') %>% 
  filter(MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Aerosol == '0b0') %>%

# read in start and end of growing season
data_grow_season <- read.csv(file.path('data', 'growing_season_yearly.csv'))
grow_season_site <- data_grow_season %>%
  group_by(site_ID) %>% 
  summarise(sos=floor((mean(sos_DER) + mean(sos_TRS)) / 2), 
            eos=ceiling((mean(eos_DER) + mean(eos_TRS)) / 2))

source(file.path("scripts", "00_functions.R"))
grow_season_site <- bind_rows(grow_season_site, data.frame(site_ID = sites_grow_yearlong, sos = 1, eos = 365))

#
sites_all <- unique(sites_long$site_ID)
LAI_seasonal_pattern_smooth <- data.frame(site_ID = character(), doy = integer(), LAI_gam = double())
for (site in sites_all) {
  tmp <- LAI_seasonal_pattern %>% filter(ID == site) 
  plot(tmp$doy, tmp$LAI, main = site)
  # adding lines of growing season
  sos <- grow_season_site$sos[grow_season_site$site_ID == site]
  eos <- grow_season_site$eos[grow_season_site$site_ID == site]
  points(x = c(sos, eos), 
         y = c(mean(tmp$LAI, na.rm=T), mean(tmp$LAI, na.rm=T)), col = 'red', pch = 19)
  
  # smooth the seasonal pattern (losses, or gam)
  loess_model <- loess(LAI ~ doy, data = tmp)
  gam_model <- gam(LAI ~ s(doy), data = tmp)
  #
  df <- data.frame(site_ID = site, doy = sos:eos)
  df$LAI_loess <- predict(loess_model, newdata = df)
  pred <- predict(gam_model, newdata = df, se.fit = TRUE)
  df$LAI_gam <- pred$fit # - pred$se.fit * 1.96 # consider noise effects
  # we finally decided to use LAI_gam, because it matches seasonal pattern better. 
  #
  lines(df$doy, df$LAI_loess, col = 'yellow')
  lines(df$doy, df$LAI_gam, col = 'blue')
  
  LAI_seasonal_pattern_smooth <- bind_rows(LAI_seasonal_pattern_smooth, df)
}

# we should use the gam smoothed line. 
# How many site-years have been missing in the data?
data_LAI <- data_LAI %>%
  mutate(weight = case_when(
    MCD15A3H_061_FparLai_QC_CloudState == '0b00' & MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Aerosol == '0b0' &
    MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Cloud_Shadow == '0b0' & MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Internal_CloudMask == '0b0' &
    MCD15A3H_061_FparLai_QC_MODLAND == '0b0' ~ 1,
    MCD15A3H_061_FparLai_QC_CloudState == '0b00' & MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Aerosol == '0b0' &
    MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Cloud_Shadow == '0b0' & MCD15A3H_061_FparExtra_QC_Internal_CloudMask == '0b0' &
    MCD15A3H_061_FparLai_QC_MODLAND != '0b0' ~ 0.5,
    TRUE ~ 0)) %>%
  left_join(LAI_seasonal_pattern_smooth, by = c("ID" = "site_ID", "doy"))


df_LAI_check_sites <- data.frame()

df_disturbance <- data.frame()
for (site in sites_all) {
  # site = 'CA-Cbo'
  
  print(site)
  #
  data_LAI_site <- data_LAI %>% filter(ID == site) 
  
  f_good_data <- data_LAI_site %>% group_by(year) %>% summarise(f = sum(weight == 1) / n()) 
  # remove a year if it has < 50% of average data
  bad_years <- f_good_data %>% filter(f < mean(f_good_data$f, na.rm=T) * 0.5) %>% pull(year)
  if (length(bad_years) > 0) {
    data_LAI_site <- data_LAI_site %>% filter(!year %in% bad_years)
  }
  
  # interpolate missing points
  data_LAI_site$LAI_intp <- data_LAI_site$LAI
  data_LAI_site$LAI_intp[data_LAI_site$weight == 0] <- NA
  data_LAI_site$LAI_intp[data_LAI_site$weight == 0.5 & data_LAI_site$LAI_intp < 0.5 * data_LAI_site$LAI_gam] <- NA
  data_LAI_site$LAI_intp <- approx(
    x = as.numeric(data_LAI_site$Date),    # time axis as numeric
    y = data_LAI_site$LAI_intp,            # values to interpolate
    xout = as.numeric(data_LAI_site$Date), # points where we want the output
    method = "linear",
    rule = 2                               # optional: extrapolate endpoints
  )$y

  if (site %in% c("CH-Lae", "CH-Dav", "CH-Aws", "CH-Fru", "CH-Cha", "US-GLE", "US-Var", "AU-Rob")) {
    df_LAI_check_sites <- bind_rows(df_LAI_check_sites, data_LAI_site)
  }
  
  #
  # get trend of growing-season LAI
  sos <- grow_season_site$sos[grow_season_site$site_ID == site]
  eos <- grow_season_site$eos[grow_season_site$site_ID == site]
  yearly_LAI_site <- data_LAI_site %>% filter(between(doy, sos, eos)) %>%
    group_by(year) %>% summarise(LAI_gs = mean(LAI_intp, na.rm=T), .groups = "drop")
  
  # correct trend's effect  
  fit <- lm(data = yearly_LAI_site, LAI_gs ~ year)
  summary(fit)
  
  if (summary(fit)$coefficients["year", "Pr(>|t|)"] < 0.05) {
    trend_annual <- fitted(fit)
    data_LAI_site <- data_LAI_site %>% left_join(data.frame(year = yearly_LAI_site$year, trend = trend_annual), by = "year")
    data_LAI_site$LAI_intp_detrend <- data_LAI_site$LAI_intp - data_LAI_site$trend + mean(data_LAI_site$trend)
    # plot(data_LAI_site$LAI_intp_detrend)
    # plot(data_LAI_site$LAI_intp)
  } else {
    data_LAI_site$LAI_intp_detrend <- data_LAI_site$LAI_intp
  }

  # calculate disturbance effects
  LAI_gs <- mean(data_LAI_site$LAI_gam[between(data_LAI_site$doy, sos, eos)], na.rm = T) * (eos - sos + 1)
  df <- data_LAI_site %>% filter(between(doy, sos, eos)) %>%
    mutate(deficit_obs = pmax(LAI_gam - LAI_intp_detrend, 0)) %>%
    group_by(ID, year) %>%
    summarise(deficit_obs = sum(deficit_obs, na.rm=T) * 4 / LAI_gs, .groups = 'drop') 
  
  plot(df$year, df$deficit_obs, main = site)
  
  df_disturbance <- bind_rows(df_disturbance, df)
}
```
